t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are two groups of gnomes. One of the groups scores highly - stick with that group. This will change randomly and go back to low scores. But when you notice a change stick with the group.

vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of gnomes, the cool coloured gnomes (green, blue, yellow and brown) and the warm coloured gnomes (orange, purple, pink and red). At some point one of these groups (either the warm or cool coloured gnomes) scores higher. This changes at random. Select a group and stick with it. When you notice you have had a couple of low scores, select the other group. E.g., choose the cool coloured gnomes and then when they score badly, select the warm coloured gnomes. However, at some points within the game, both groups of gnomes score badly.
